svg.title: The folders of the default path template
svg.desc: The base folder Documents/Paperless holds three folders: Inbox, the inbox folder; Archive, the archive folder; and Failed imports, the error folder. Archive holds a folder per correspondent, such as Example GmbH, and _Deleted, the deleted folder. In the folder of a correspondent, a folder per document type, such as Invoice, holds a folder per year, such as 2026, which holds the file 2026-08-26 - Example invoice [P123].pdf, built from created, title, the marker with the id and the extension.
